messages:
Lina (AE): Kicking off HelioBank pilot alignment thread — need to lock success metrics, golden prompts, timeline, and flag any enterprise blockers.
Sam (Sales Eng): Quick context: customer wants 3-week pilot, ingest their FAQ + 10k support transcripts, and test account recovery and compliance flows.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For eval harness: propose a 1k example golden anchor set (balanced across intents: auth, payments, disputes, product) + 400 edge-case fuzz prompts.
Lina (AE): Sounds good. Also Helio asked about white-glove pricing if we bring Dedicated for throughput. Can we ballpark?
Sam (Sales Eng): Ballpark: hosted API covers small pilots; Dedicated ~2.5-3x hosted cost at steady 50k tokens/day but gives isolation and predictable p95. I'll draft numbers.
Carlos (Security): Heads up — Helio's security questionnaire requires SOC2 type II, data residency in eu-west-1, and client-managed KMS for keys. Private deployment preferred for regulated datasets.
Dan (Product): From product side: we need to ensure model variant supports function-calling for structured account objects. Also latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for single-turn queries.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Functional correctness: weighted scorer >= 0.8 across golden set
- Safety/regression: zero critical FPs on PII redaction tests
- Perf: p95 latency < 300ms, error rate < 1%
- Ops: automated rollback if model quality drops >5% from baseline
Sam (Sales Eng): For scoring, recommend a combined metric: 60% semantic match (human-annotated), 20% exact-match for structured fields (account_id, txn_id), 20% latency/availability penalty.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Example scoring block:```
weights = {"semantics": 0.6, "structured": 0.2, "perf_penalty": 0.2}
final_score = semantics_score * weights['semantics'] + structured_score * weights['structured'] - perf_penalty
```
Lina (AE): Good. Helio will want a pass/fail gate for go/no-go at week 3 and regression gates per deploy. How do we define the regression gate?
Priya (Solutions Eng): Regression gate: if golden-set average drops >4 percentage points relative to baseline or any critical intent F1 drops >0.07, block rollout. Also require at least one human spot-check of 50 samples after changes.
Carlos (Security): On the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 and KMS options, but Private (VPC) deploy adds ~2 weeks to setup. Need legal sign-off and network peering details from Helio.
Sam (Sales Eng): Blockers to call out to Helio: (1) data residency and KMS, (2) timeline impact for Private deploy, (3) need seed sample of 500 transcripts for cold-start tuning.
Lina (AE): I'll ask Helio for the 500-sample seed and confirm decision on Private vs Hosted by Friday.
Dan (Product): One more product note — we'll surface token-level cost estimates in the Console per-route so Helio can see economics during pilot.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist for the pilot:
- ingest pipeline + scrubber (PII policy)
- golden set + annotation rubric (we'll provide template)
- scoring harness (CI job) with deterministic seeds
- canary rollout config and automatic fallback policy
Sam (Sales Eng): I'll attach the pricing sketch and a sample annotation rubric in the follow-up message.
redwood-bot: Reminder: create a shared Google folder and add Helio SSO group once approved.
Lina (AE): Action items: @Sam share pricing + rubric by EOD, @Priya push harness template and weights, @Carlos list required security artifacts for Legal. I'll coordinate with Helio for the seed data and sign-off timeline.
Carlos (Security): I'll compile the security artifact checklist (SOC2 cert, encryption details, network diagram) and post here.
Priya (Solutions Eng): One ask from Helio product: can we surface a per-intent error breakdown in the Console? Product team can probably add a temporary dashboard for the pilot.
Dan (Product): Yes — we can create a pilot dashboard with per-intent metrics and alerting. Need sample intent taxonomy from Helio.
Lina (AE): Excellent. I'll confirm taxonomy with them and loop back.
Sam (Sales Eng): Noted. Follow-ups: pricing doc (sent), rubric draft (sent). Will ping when uploaded. :thumbsup:
Lina (AE): Thanks team — want a short sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize gates if that works.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Works for me.
Carlos (Security): Works.
Dan (Product): In.
redwood-bot: Meeting created: Helio pilot alignment — tomorrow 10:00 PT.
